verdict.rationale: For a GPU accelerator, the documented public API is its programming and management interfaces. AMD's docs cover the HIP runtime and programming model plus AMD SMI for managing and monitoring GPUs, so the MI355X can be driven programmatically through first-party APIs. However, the evidence is only short index-page snippets, and the OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable API spec. Missing for 10: explicit API reference documentation (HIP/AMD SMI function references), evidence of programmatic or agent-friendly control beyond tool descriptions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
